adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces an embed loading flow with no failure/timeout path: `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb` always reloads every 30s (`setTimeout(... document.location.reload() ...)`) and never transitions to an error state. In `lib/topic_retriever.rb#fetch_http`, if the configured `embed_by_username` user cannot be found (`return if user.blank?`), the retrieval is abandoned without creating a `TopicEmbed` and without surfacing any error, causing the embed endpoint (`EmbedController#best`) to keep rendering the loading view indefinitely. Additionally, retrieval errors from `TopicEmbed.import_remote` (uses `open(url).read` with no rescue) would also prevent embed creation, leaving the UI stuck reloading with no in-band diagnostics.
